body.name: Tenant Administration
body.description: Tenant structure and direct protected actions for a tenant administrator.

permissions.label: Open Tenant Administration
permissions.description: Allows opening the Tenant Administration application.

permissions.label: Manage Tenant Administration
permissions.description: Allows managing Tenant Administration definition-level administration.

permissions.label: Read organisations
permissions.description: Allows reading the protected organisation projection as a system record.

permissions.label: Move organisations
permissions.description: Allows invoking an organisation move; the protected operation also requires the tenant reparent capability.

permissions.label: Read tenant administrators
permissions.description: Allows reading the protected tenant-administrator projection as a system record.

text.value: Review the organisations in this tenant. Select an organisation to see its details, or use Tenant structure for its protected actions. Tenant administrators are listed on their own page.
The signed-in administrator who creates this child organisation becomes its first organisation steward.

help_text.value: Use lowercase words separated by underscores.

label.value: Your display name in the new organisation

help_text.value: Enter a language tag such as en or en-NZ.
Enter an IANA time zone such as Pacific/Auckland.
Enter a three-letter ISO currency code such as NZD.

text.value: Tenant administrators are read live from protected Identity data under your current authority; nothing is copied into application records. Granting and revoking tenant-administrator access runs through IAM, never from this application.

literal.value: Move the organisation shown in this row under the selected parent organisation?
The organisation changed since this row was shown. Refresh the page and choose Move organisation again.
The organisation could not be moved with your current access and the selected parent.
The organisation move is invalid. Refresh the page and select a permitted parent organisation.
